_note: Model chain for the agent. Order set by the owner 2026-11-06: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, Groq gpt-oss-120b, gemini-3.8-flash; change only if the full Groq test gives strong evidence. First entry is primary; the rest are fallbacks in order. Override with env SKYQ_MODEL_CHAIN='groq:openai/gpt-oss-120b,google:gemini-3.5-flash-lite'. Keys come from .env only. Verified 2026-11-05: Groq key serves gpt-oss-120b/20b, qwen3.8-27b (llama-3.3-70b returns 404); Gemini 2.5 Flash is retired for new users. gpt-oss-120b needs reasoning_effort 'medium': with 'low', Groq rejected 3/3 answers (output_parse_failed); medium answered 3/3. 2026-11-06: gemini-3.1-flash-lite added before gemini-3.8-flash after a 13-question sample (13/14 turns; the miss was a wording check) and a provider 429 showing its quota is per model (GenerateRequestsPerMinutePerProjectPerModel-FreeTier, model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite) while gemini-3.5-flash-lite kept answering. gemini-3.8-flash stays last resort (20 RPD).

free_tier_checked_2026_11_05.google: Per-model free-tier quotas from the owner's AI Studio (2026-11-06; usage there is a 28-day peak). Provider 429 bodies name the quota per project per model.

quota._note: Shared limits for all visitors (backend/agent/quota.py). Effective cap = provider limit x safety_margin; public visitors stop at (1 - demo_reserve) of the daily caps, demo requests may use the reserve. Override per model with env SKYQ_PROVIDER_LIMITS='{"google:gemini-3.5-flash-lite":{"rpd":1000}}', or SKYQ_QUOTA_SAFETY_MARGIN / SKYQ_DEMO_RESERVE. question_requests = measured max model requests per question (scripts/measure_requests.py).

groq:openai/gpt-oss-120b.source: RPD and TPM from live Groq response headers 2026-11-05; RPM and TPD from Groq docs. TPD behaved as a rolling 24 h window.

google:gemini-3.5-flash-lite.source: Google AI Studio, owner's project, 2026-11-06 (AI Studio usage figures are 28-day peaks, not today's use). No provider daily token limit; daily_token_budget is our own cap. RPD resets at midnight Pacific.
